basis: data/rcap-all50/overlays/production/alaska/tf-805-form-en/field-census.json (inherited; field names and printed label fragments only)
basisLimits: Every entry below is read from committed repository records. None was read from the official TF-805 binary, which is absent from this environment (see source-verification.json). Entries whose answer lives on the form itself are marked unresolved rather than inferred.

venue.detail: The route record names one destination kind (court) and no per-borough or per-district branching. Alaska's trial courts are a unitary state system, so no county-level filing-office variation is recorded.
venue.unresolved: Which specific trial court location receives the request -- the court that heard the underlying case -- is matter-specific and is a participant-supplied fact, not a route constant.

fee.sourceReviewSays: The source review does not state a filing fee for this request.
fee.unresolved: Whether Administrative Rule 40(b)/(c) requests carry a filing fee, and whether any borough or court location varies it, is not established by any committed record. This must not be presented to a participant as fee-free.

feeWaiver.sourceReviewSays: The source review does not address a fee waiver.
feeWaiver.conditionDescription: Applies only when the participant cannot pay the filing fee.
feeWaiver.unresolved: Dependent on the unresolved fee question above. No waiver instrument is named in the packet set.

verificationAndNotarization.sourceReviewSays: The source review does not state a notarization requirement beyond the sworn verification.
verificationAndNotarization.participantAction: The requestor signs and swears to their own request in the TF-805 verification block.

deliveryAndService.instrument: The certificate of service is part of TF-805 itself, on page 2. The packet set does not add a separate service document.

methodControlsObservedInInheritedCensus.readsAs: unresolved -- the printed label fragment carried in the inherited census is truncated and the binary is absent, so this abbreviation is not expanded here

deliveryAndService.timingRule: The certificate states service on a date and time. It is a statement of something that has already happened, so it cannot be completed before the participant actually serves.
deliveryAndService.unresolved: Who must be served, and whether the served set varies by court location, is not established by any committed record. The form carries a free-text 'I served these people' field rather than a fixed list, which is consistent with a matter-specific served set.

filing.detail: File the request with the local trial court. The participant may initiate; the process actor is the court.

postFilingConstraint.detail: A label fragment inherited from the census reads 'five years, you must file a new request if yo...'. This indicates a recurrence or re-request window attached to the relief.
postFilingConstraint.unresolved: The exact rule, its trigger and its duration are not established here; the fragment is truncated and the binary is absent. Do not state a five-year rule to a participant on the strength of this fragment.

testStatus.because: The route record requires each variation to be recorded AND tested. Testing a filing, fee, venue or delivery variation means exercising it against a rendered packet, and no packet can be rendered while the source binary is absent. Recording is complete to the limit of committed sources; testing is blocked.
